text:
Ethene reacts with water under suitable conditions.
Which statement about this reaction is correct?
A
The product of this reaction has an Mr of 46.
B
The reaction produces two different products.
C
The reaction occurs when ethene gas is bubbled into cold water in the presence of an acid
catalyst.
D
The reaction is a redox reaction.
